name: Barnaby
description: Barnaby is an affectionate, fluffy soul with silky golden fur who loves belly rubs, outdoor hikes, and learning fun new tricks.
story: Rescued from a rural shelter during the rainy season. Barnaby graduated top of his basic agility training class.
healthStatus: Fully vaccinated, microchipped & clear vet checkup.

name: Mimi & Luna
description: A bonded sister pair—one sleek midnight black and one sweet white & tabby—who groom each other, purr in harmony, and enjoy sunny window watchtowers.
story: Fostered together since kittenhood. They bring double the affection and quiet companionship.
healthStatus: Up to date on FVRCP vaccines, dewormed & spayed.

name: Oliver
description: Gentle, curious, and litter-box trained. Oliver enjoys fresh cilantro, cardboard tunnels, and gentle head scratches.
story: Surrendered due to family relocation. Oliver is accustomed to indoor free-roaming life.

name: Daisy
description: Daisy is a brilliant, eager-to-please Border Collie mix with a fluffy feathered coat. She loves fetch, exploring trails, and curling up beside you after a fun run.
story: Found on a country farm and lovingly fostered. Daisy is house-trained, walks politely on leash, and thrives with active humans.
healthStatus: Heartworm negative, current on DHPP & Rabies.

name: Jasper
description: A handsome silver mackerel tabby with striking amber eyes and a calm demeanor. Jasper greets you at the door and purrs contentedly while you work.
story: Transferred from partner rescue. He makes the best conversationalist during remote work calls.
healthStatus: Dental scaling completed recently, full blood panel pristine.

name: Teddy
description: A lovable, wrinkly English Bulldog and certified champion snuggler. Teddy enjoys leisurely neighborhood waddles, tummy rubs, and cozy afternoon naps on the couch.
story: Rescued when his previous family downsized. Teddy is gentle, completely house-broken, and the ultimate loyal cuddle buddy.
healthStatus: Core vaccines up to date, neutered, clear joint & airway screening.
